title: SMOOTH LOOK, A SMALLER PILLAGER, A BIGGER BULWARK
why: His notes of 2026-10-25 on the photos: I dont like the pixelated style, I want the graphics smooth; Pillager still too big; Bulwark still too small. The smooth look is the default again and a save that holds the pixel look moves to it once (the pixel look stays as an experimental switch). Every human figure is drawn at 0.8 of the old size (drawing only). The bulwark is drawn and hit at 1.5 times the other machines, about twice its old art; it walks and fits doors on the old radius.
now: The game looks smooth again (the pixel look is off, saved games too). Pillagers are drawn a fifth smaller. The bulwark is about twice as big and easier to hit. Watch for: name plates sitting right over heads, the smaller pillager staying easy to spot in a fight, and the bulwark art overlapping walls when it hugs one.
